rules.threshold_text: 50 MW of new or incremental load with a load factor of 85 percent or higher
rules.contract_term: Minimum term not less than 20 years from the In-Service Date, including the Load Ramp Period; customer notice at least two years before terminating service (as filed, approved with the settlement's modifications, which do not change the term)
rules.collateral: Performance security: counterparties rated BBB or better, a parent guaranty equal to the present value of five years of incremental generation charge revenues (parent liquidity above five years of the obligation, reviewed annually); rated below BBB, a letter of credit or surety bond equal to the present value of ten years; unrated, FPL's internal credit review, five or ten years
rules.exit_fee: Early termination charges equivalent to 100 percent of the Incremental Generation Charge for the remaining term of the LLCS Service Agreement, as FPL's witness describes the tariff (settlement rebuttal testimony, 3 October 2025); the tariff sheet with the charge (8.952) was not read
rules.study_timeline: Engineering and system impact studies (System Studies) required; after FPL provides the study, the customer has six months to execute the Construction and Operating Agreement and pay any CIAC, with one 3-month extension per study on request (9 months total); no capacity guaranteed until the LLCS Service Agreement is executed and deposits paid; no study duration printed
